lines.zh: 阴影中缓缓走出一个身影。
lines.en: A figure emerges from the shadows.
Sibilant steps move forward.
Silent in the dark.
It stares ahead, closing the distance.
Its footsteps are light.

lines.zh: 影子在地面上拉长，它逼近。
lines.en: The shadow stretches, advancing.
It whispers as it walks.

lines.zh: 阴影中的脚步声渐渐清晰。
lines.en: The footsteps grow clearer.
It walks with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中移动，无声无息。
lines.en: It moves in the dark, silent.
It slides along the wall, casting no shadow.
It crosses the whole corridor in one step.

lines.zh: 理智一空，我就有了身体。
lines.en: When your sanity empties, I get a body.
Its eyes are vacant.
It waits, motionless.
It stands in the shadow.
You should rest. Come with me.
It stares at the player.
It watches the player.
It stands in the shadows.
It glares at the player.
It stands in silence.
It stands at the very edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 它数着你抽屉里的药片
lines.en: It counts the pills in your drawer.
Its breathing falls into rhythm with yours.

lines.zh: 它抬手指向不存在的门
lines.en: It raises a hand toward a door that is not there.
It turns to look at the player.
Its eyes fix on the player.
It locks on to the player.
It looks at the player, eyes vacant.
It stares at the player.

lines.zh: 我站在床边，数你的呼吸。
lines.en: I stand by the bed and count your breaths.
It meets the player's gaze.
It looks at the player.
It gazes at the player.

lines.zh: 我的脸贴在窗玻璃外面。
lines.en: My face is pressed against the window glass.

lines.zh: 它站在蒲公英的阴影下
lines.en: It stands beneath the dandelion’s shadow.
Its face is a hand’s width from yours.
It reads your sanity as it crumbles.
You dare not turn, and it is there anyway.

lines.zh: 它的眼里映出你的样子
lines.en: Its eyes reflect what you have become.
It looks at you first, from inside the mirror.

lines.zh: 你每眨一次眼，我就近一步。
lines.en: Every blink brings me one step closer.

lines.zh: 它歪头学你恐惧的表情
lines.en: It tilts its head and copies your fear.

lines.zh: 它在门缝后看你一整夜
lines.en: It watched you all night through the door gap.
Your shadow turns; it does not.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声，你离真相更近了。
lines.en: Sssssss, closer to the truth.

lines.zh: 影中人轻笑，你无法逃脱。
lines.en: The man from the shadow laughs, you cannot escape.
Your sanity is fading.

lines.zh: 阴影中的声音在召唤你。
lines.en: The voice from the shadows calls you.
Come, paradise is there.
The flame of sanity is dying.

lines.zh: 阴影中的眼睛在注视你。
lines.en: Eyes in the shadows watch you.
Did you hear something?

lines.zh: 理智正在消逝，不要放弃。
lines.en: Sanity is fading, do not give up.
Do not let the truth consume you.

lines.zh: 它长着苍白的皮肤，眼神空洞。
lines.en: Pale skin, empty gaze.

lines.zh: 它的声音像寒风一样刺骨。
lines.en: Its voice like icy wind.

lines.zh: 你感到它用目光穿透你的理智。
lines.en: It pierces your sanity with its gaze.

lines.zh: 你看到它的眼睛闪烁着希望之光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with hope.

lines.zh: 它轻声呼唤，试图拉你入深渊。
lines.en: It whispers, drawing you down.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中等待你的决心。
lines.en: It waits in the dark for your resolve.

lines.zh: 它的触摸让你的理智崩溃。
lines.en: Its touch crumbles your sanity.

lines.zh: 你感到它在吞噬你的意志。
lines.en: It devours your will.
It terrifies you.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，试图诱惑你。
lines.en: It whispers, tempting you.

lines.zh: 它突然出现在你的面前。
lines.en: It appears suddenly.

lines.zh: 它的身影在黑暗中若隐若现。
lines.en: Its form flickers in the dark.

lines.zh: 你和它撞个正着，无法避开。
lines.en: You collide with it, unable to avoid.

lines.zh: 它的速度太快，你避无可避。
lines.en: Its speed leaves you no room to dodge.

lines.zh: 它似乎能预见你的动作。
lines.en: It seems to predict your moves.

lines.zh: 它在你的攻击中毫发无损。
lines.en: It remains unharmed by your attacks.

lines.zh: 你试图攻击，但它躲开了。
lines.en: You attack, but it dodges.

lines.zh: 你撞到了空气，我就站在那。
lines.en: You hit empty air; I stood right there.

lines.zh: 你感到它的力量超越了你。
lines.en: You feel its power over you.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让你喘不过气来。
lines.en: Its attacks make you gasp for breath.
It seeks out its kind.

lines.zh: 它的声音在夜晚格外响亮。
lines.en: Its voice is loud at night.

lines.zh: 它寻找着愿意跟随的灵魂。
lines.en: It seeks willing souls to follow.

lines.zh: 它的存在是孤独的化身。
lines.en: It is the embodiment of loneliness.
It craves new companionship.

lines.zh: 它的目光中充满了渴望。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with desire.
It seeks a home.

lines.zh: 它的存在是无法言说的孤独。
lines.en: It is an unspeakable loneliness.

lines.zh: 它的同类散布在黑暗中。
lines.en: Its kind lurks in the dark.
It shares secrets with its kind.
Sssssss, do you feel it?
Your sanity is draining fast.
Come with me, don't struggle.

lines.zh: 把手伸给我，我带你去天堂。
lines.en: Give me your hand — I'll take you to heaven.

lines.zh: 别反抗，你的心脏在跳动。
lines.en: Don't resist, your heart is beating.

lines.zh: 看这扇门，天堂就在里面。
lines.en: Look at that door, heaven is inside.
Your fear makes me stronger.
Sanity drained, you can't resist.
Only medicine can save you.
Your soul is about to join mine.
Prey has appeared, began.

lines.zh: 你就是我要找的那个人。
lines.en: You are the one I'm looking for.
Come closer, you'll get answers.
You're in my hand, don't move.

lines.zh: 感受我的力量，你会屈服。
lines.en: Feel my power, you'll submit.
You belong to the darkness, to me.
You're one step from heaven.
Don't struggle, accept my guidance.

lines.zh: 你是我的，永远都别想逃脱。
lines.en: You are mine, never escape.

lines.zh: 你将被带往最终目的地。
lines.en: You will be taken to the final destination.
At last it has chosen you.
It says your name, softly.

lines.zh: 它说天堂为你留了位置
lines.en: It says heaven has kept a place for you.
It drops every illusion and shows only itself.
The pills you swallowed no longer work.

lines.zh: 它从你背后的空气里走出
lines.en: It steps out of the air behind you.
Target locked, take now.
Your heart is racing, interesting.
Stare at you, don't blink.
You're almost done.
My claws will take you.
Feel my presence, don't avoid.
You can't escape my circle.

lines.zh: 你的心跳告诉我下一步。
lines.en: Your heartbeat guides my next step.

lines.zh: 你即将成为我的一部分。
lines.en: You'll be part of me soon.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是你的终结。
lines.en: My presence is your end.

lines.zh: 它停在一步外，不再靠近
lines.en: It stops one step away and comes no closer.
It lets you walk toward it on your own.
It describes heaven into your ear.

lines.zh: 你的手脚开始不听使唤
lines.en: Your hands and feet stop obeying you.
It erases the exits one by one.

lines.zh: 它耐心得像等了几十年
lines.en: It is patient as one who has waited decades.

lines.zh: 它的影子盖住你的蒲公英
lines.en: Its shadow covers your dandelion.
It whispers: only one step left.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的呼吸变慢
lines.en: You hear your own breathing slow.
It opens its palm and waits for you to take it.
Sssssss, you’ve broken the taboo!

lines.zh: 跟我走，享受无尽的安详。
lines.en: Come with me, find eternal peace.

lines.zh: 理智耗尽，坠入我的梦魇。
lines.en: Your sanity fades, plunge into my nightmare.

lines.zh: 你的朋友已屈服，你也将如此。
lines.en: Your friends have succumbed, so will you.
Dance with death, embrace eternal life.

lines.zh: 你已无处可逃，我的囚徒。
lines.en: Nowhere to run, my prisoner.
Pain is the path to salvation.
You will witness the end of eternity.

lines.zh: 我的力量超越你的想象。
lines.en: My power exceeds your imagination.
Time stands still in our realm.
It grips your shoulder, cold to the bone.

lines.zh: 幻觉与真实的痛一同袭来
lines.en: Hallucination and real pain strike together.

lines.zh: 它把你的意识拖出一寸
lines.en: It drags your mind an inch out of your body.

lines.zh: 你看见自己的手打自己
lines.en: You see your own hand strike you.

lines.zh: 它的指尖抹去一段记忆
lines.en: Its fingertip erases a piece of your memory.

lines.zh: 它把你按进墙里，墙像水
lines.en: It pushes you into the wall, and the wall yields like water.
Darkness calls for new souls.
Your world is about to end.
Lost in endless shadows.
Fear is the only escape.
Your will cannot stop me.
Await your arrival.
Night in the wild, my prey.
Pain is the only language.
Soul returns to darkness.
Ingest the depths of sanity.

lines.zh: 理智崩塌那晚，它成形了
lines.en: The night your sanity broke, it took shape.

lines.zh: 它从服药后的空白里走出
lines.en: It steps out of the blank after your dose.

lines.zh: 蒲公英的花瓣全部落尽
lines.en: Every petal of the dandelion has fallen.

lines.zh: 你身后的呼吸不属于你
lines.en: The breath behind you is no longer yours.
The shadow rises first; the man follows.

lines.zh: 它穿过了一扇锁着的门
lines.en: It passes through a locked door.

lines.zh: 有人在黑暗里念你的名字
lines.en: Someone in the dark is saying your name.

lines.zh: 你回头，房里多了一个人
lines.en: You turn, and there is one more person in the room.

lines.zh: 它沿着天花板裂纹爬下
lines.en: It climbs down the cracks in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 钟停在你失眠的第三夜
lines.en: The clock stops on your third sleepless night.
Flames tear at your skin.

lines.zh: 阴影中的爪子抓住了你。
lines.en: Claws from the shadows grab you.
Suffocation from the shadows.
Explosion tears your shadow.
Arrow from the shadows pierces you.

lines.zh: 黑暗魔法撕裂你的理智。
lines.en: Dark magic tears at your sanity.
Hunger from the shadows.
Lightning strikes your shadow.
Shadows consume you.
